name: Global EbA Fund Small-Size Grants

funder.name: International Climate Initiative (IKI), German Federal Ministry for the Environment (BMUKN)

summary: Grants of up to USD 250,000 from the Global EbA Fund for catalytic projects that remove barriers to ecosystem-based adaptation, with a focus on small island developing states and least developed countries.

geography.label: Global or thematic projects, or ODA-eligible countries

reporting: Grantees must build at least three indicators from the Fund's Core Indicator Framework into their project logframe; the Fund uses them to monitor and report project outcomes.

eligibility.rule: Lead applicant and partners are legally recognised entities

documents: Theory of Change, Logframe and Project Activities Form
Detailed budget in the Excel template
Due Diligence and Financial Capacity Questionnaire
Articles of Incorporation, Constitution, Statutes or Government Decree
Organisation in-country registration certificate, if applicable
CVs of main personnel assigned to the project

calls.label: 8th Call for Proposals for Small-Size Grants

status.quote: Small-size grants will accept applications beginning 28 September and will close on 26 October.

administered_by.quote: Implemented by IUCN and UNEP, with funding from the International Climate Initiative (IKI) of the German Federal Ministry for the Environment, Climate Action, Nature Conservation and Nuclear Safety (BMUKN)

applicant_types.quote: Non-governmental organisations (NGOs) International non-governmental organisations (INGOs) Intergovernmental organisations (IGOs) Community-based organisations (CBOs) Indigenous People's Organisations Universities and other academic institutions Research institutes and think tanks Private sector companies

geography.quote: Project is Global, Thematic, or otherwise targets only ODA-eligible countries.

access.quote: All applications must be submitted on the online platform.

amount.quote: Grant Size: each grant up to USD 250,000

co_finance_required.quote: Own- or third-party funds are not a requirement; however, co-financing from the applicant would demonstrate an institutional investment in the project.

consortium_required.quote: For projects with country-level activities a consortium with one or more local organizations is required with at least 25% of the budget allocated to local partners

reporting.quote: Applicants must identify at least three relevant indicators from the Core Indicator Framework and incorporate them into the individual project's logical framework.

eligibility.quote: Project must be built / based off existing work.
Lead applicant and partner organisations must be legally recognised entities.

documents.quote: Applicant Declaration Co-applicant Mandate Small-Size Grants Application Form Theory of Change, Logframe and Project Activities Form* Project Proposal Budget Template Due Diligence and Financial Capacity Questionnaire
Annex 1(c)(i): Articles of Incorporation, Constitution, Statutes, Government Decree, as appropriate; and Annex: 1(c)(ii): Organisation in-country registration certificate (if applicable)

you will also be asked to provide the CVs of main personnel assigned to the project. Documents in all the sections must be submitted in English. All supporting documents that are not in English must be accompanied by an English translation.

effort.quote: All applications must be submitted on the online platform.
Duly submitted project proposals will be reviewed by expert reviewers
Only shortlisted applicants will be requested to submit:

after_award.quote: Grantees are required to report on the progress of their respective projects on a 6-months basis.
It is required to undertake an external audit for the project funded by the Global EbA Fund.

steps: ESMS questionnaire and remaining due diligence, if shortlisted
